01-portrait.why: Likeness of a single face in soft window light. The man must be instantly recognizable: face shape, eyes, nose, beard/hair, skin tone. A person or scene with no meaningful setting, so the background should be the blue-to-pink Lotería sky.

02-family-gathering.why: Thirteen people with small faces. Everyone in the photo must still be there (count them), each with their own distinct face; no one added, merged, or dropped. The beach setting carries the moment, so it should be kept and restyled.

03-dog-closeup.why: Tight crop of a dog's face cut off at the frame edge. The dog's markings and coloring must match, and the crop should still read as a deliberate card composition.

04-hockey-action.why: Several players in motion with a crowd and advertising text on the boards. The ad text must not leak into the illustration as readable or garbled lettering; the players and action should stay clear.

05-thanksgiving-table.why: A table of many small objects. The main dishes should stay recognizable without the image turning cluttered. An object scene: a flat solid color background fits better than the sky.
